blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Department of Education and the Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education (MBHTE) and th have forged a partnership to advance education reforms and address longstanding challenges in the Bangsamoro education system. Education Secretary Sonny Angara and Bangsamoro Education Minister Naguib Sinarimbo met at the former’s office on Monday to discuss areas of collaboration, focused on improving teacher development, expanding access to education in under-served communities, strengthening institutional capacity, and improving school facilities and learning resources. During the meeting, Sinarimbo presented the current state of education in the Bangsamoro region, including learning outcomes and the results of […]...
